notes.title: Balance Patch 1.0.2a
notes.notes:
Overview
After several weeks of monitoring player data, it has become apparent that several changes may be useful to improve game balance. First, Act 1-3 (Apa Kanul) has proved to be a bit too challenging for some, with roughly 30% of all players getting 'stuck' on that level. Second, Units can feel a bit too squishy, especially in the late game. And finally, Relic choices are sometimes difficult to notice, feeling inconsequential. In an attempt to address these, the following changes have been introduced:

Act 1-3 (Apa Kanul):
- Enemy Health for Wave 11 thru 25 reduced by 3-10%
- Windmill Health increased 30%

Units (General):
- Base Health scaling multiplier doubled
- Damage scaling multipliers increased 15%

Relics:
- Pit Boss Pickaxe: Mining Speed increased from +5% to +8%
- Golden Dagger: Gold Bonus increased from +20 to +40
- Fishmonger's Butcher Knife: Unit Damage increased from +2 to +4
- Adjudicator Staff: Mage Tower Damage increased from +5% to +8%
- Scythe: All Damage increased from +10% to +12%
	
Thank you to all who have played the game so far! Please leave feedback on what you think of the changes, and let me know if there's anything else you'd like to see.

notes.title: Fortitude Tower Defense: Release Date
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce the time for war will soon commence as Fortitude Tower Defense is officially set to release April 2, 2025!

Thank you to all who have played the demo over the past month. Your feedback is highly valued, and I have rolled nearly all of it into the final build. 

If you haven't had a chance to try out the FREE demo, what are you waiting for? Get in there, it's fun. You'll like it.
